Members of the public wishing to make public comment may do so in one of the following ways:

(1) Call-in Conference – (669) 444-9171; Meeting ID 870 1432 6414 and then press #. Press # again

(2) Email or Telephone – All interested parties can submit comments in advance to the Planning
  Division’s general email at planning@elmonteca.gov or by calling the City’s telephone line: (626)
  258-8626. All comments must be received by the Planning Division no later than 12:00 pm on
  November 14, 2023.

  accessibility to this meeting. [28 Code of Federal Regulations 35.102-35.104 ADA Title II]

  General explanation of how the meeting is conducted:
  1. The staff report is presented by City staff.
  2. The City Art in Public Places Advisory Committee (APPAC) ask questions if necessary for
  clarification.
  3. The applicant makes a presentation to the City APPAC.
  4. Individuals speaking in favor or opposition of the project address the City APPAC.
  5. The applicant responds to project comments.
  6. City APPAC members discuss the project.
  7. City APPAC members vote on the project.
  8. The project is forwarded to the City Council for final decision (unless directed otherwise).
